content.comment_body: Thank you for sharing this [url]. The videos are worth watching. My feedback for [company_name]: The video image quality is excellent. The English audio is good, but the term 'NO switch' should be more clearly described as 'normally open switch.' The German audio sounds somewhat muffled. There's also a spelling error in the English subtitles. The downloadable file is large. It would be helpful to provide a version with reduced video quality to decrease the file size. The presenter, [user_name], is engaging and delivers the content with enthusiasm, especially during the closing remarks. The videos are concise and offer practical tips that viewers can learn from. I appreciate [company_name] for providing this high-quality learning resource. Best regards.
Sharing feedback is always helpful. It would be even better to submit such comments through the website where the [url] for the download is listed.

The content has been updated with new features: • Networking [product_name] using drag & drop • Coloring connection lines • Programming tasks: Light and fan control • Added: PI controller programming • Added: Webserver programming • Added: Function keys programming • Added: Changing parameters programming • Added: Using [product_name] Access Tool for data reading
Thank you for sharing this information. Regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Users appreciate the educational video resources provided by [company_name], praising the professional presentation and usefulness. Feedback points include inconsistencies in audio quality between language tracks, clarity of terminology in the English audio, spelling mistakes in subtitles, and the large size of downloadable videos. Users recognize the recent updates and view ongoing improvements positively.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect accessible, high-quality video lessons with clear and consistent audio, correct English terminology and spelling, and reasonable download sizes. They value frequent updates and concise, relevant learning content.
